title: Interface Catalogue
description: Catalogue of logical point-to-point interfaces between platforms in the Application Domains & Platforms Catalogue (APP-DAP), describing how applications across the estate exchange data.

meta.description: The logical interfaces that connect platforms across the application landscape, and the direction of data flow between them.
purpose: Makes the integration landscape visible — which platforms talk to which, and how
Captures the direction of data flow between platforms, independent of the underlying integration technology
Provides the logical-layer counterpart to APP-DAP, helping identify integration hotspots and single points of failure
Supports impact analysis — if a platform changes, which interfaces are affected?
